verdict.rationale: Adyen is a payments platform and API provider. It is not an AI agent or LLM host that would act as an MCP client consuming other servers' tools, so this story is a category error for this kind of product. Its documented MCP server is the server role and belongs to a separate story, and its agentic-commerce APIs have external AI agents calling Adyen rather than Adyen consuming MCP tools. Neither makes this client axis applicable.
